# Vendored TopK protos

Copied from the `protos/` directory of the TopK SDK repository at tag v0.16.1 (commit `4864a16`),
the same release as `topk-js` 0.16.1. MIT licensed, see `LICENSE`.

Regenerate the TypeScript codec in `src/topk/gen` with `npm run proto`. Update these files only
together with a new SDK release, and record the change in `CHANGELOG.md`.
